# UNCANNY

Current public release: v0.20.0-alpha.1 — ELYSIUM Engine 4.5 — HF18.13
BuildId: elysium45-hf18.13
updateSerial: 1930
ABI: 143
Package: UNCANNY-v0.20.0-alpha.1-ELYSIUM-ENGINE45-HF18.13.zip
SHA-256: c4faffd66ca5addfd7c200b08d46d279c5aa3274fabdae643280242845fca522
Release: https://github.com/coye2/UNCANNY/releases/latest

UNCANNY is a Windows real-time graphics remastering runtime for games and emulators.

HF18.13 fixes the D3D12 warmup/resize regression reproduced by PCSX2 after a few seconds of gameplay. Present remains fail-open. Owned D3D12 resize gets a bounded transactional handoff and off-Present warmup is serialized against resize for the same swapchain.

Modern dynamically-bound games start natively first, require a stable visible window before late attach, and can recover verified stale/headless UNCANNY sessions without auto-terminating a visible game.

PCSX2 remains on Direct3D 12 Renderer=15. HF18.11 staged direct-D3D11 neural promotion remains in place.

The native ELYSIUM path and optional neural/DLSS 5 route are separate. REVENANT asset replacement is experimental.
